# Objective

- `Sprite` components are not included in scene (de)serialization.
- Fixes #8206

## Solution

- Add `#[reflect(Component, Default)]` to `Sprite`
- Add `#[derive(FromReflect)]` to `Sprite` and `Anchor`

issue_context.title: bevy_reflect: Add `ReflectComponent` registration for `Sprite`
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Currently, `Sprite` components are not included in scene (de)serialization.

## What solution would you like?

The `Sprite` component derives both `Reflect` and `Component`, but is missing a registration for `ReflectComponent`. This type data should be registered— either by adding `#[reflect(Component)]` or `app.register_type_data::<Sprite, ReflectComponent>()`.

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/4f16d6e0dc14c12ab29b72880d5d3d22003eed72/crates/bevy_sprite/src/sprite.rs#L6-L8

This should also probably be handled for other components in `bevy_sprite` where useful, such as for `Anchor` and `TextureAtlasSprite`.

## Additional context

Original issue posted on [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/691052431525675048/742569353878437978/1089058417773125694).
